newsitem.title: USA: IBM estimates cut by Prudential, keeps buy.
newsitem.headline: IBM estimates cut by Prudential, keeps buy.

text.p: Prudential Securities analyst Don Young cut his fourth quarter and 1997 earnings estimate on International Business Machines Corp, to include higher expenses, but he maintains a buy rating, his office said.
Young cut his fourth quarter estimate to $4.10 a share, down from $4.18 a share, and cut his 1997 estimate to $12.50 a share, down from $13.50 a share previously.

"We still think the IBM story is a good one," said a contact in Young's office, adding that the analyst maintains a price target on IBM of $160, over the next 12 months. IBM shares were up 1/2 to 129-7/8, off its session high of 135-3/8.
